What if startup ideas die on the vine because they see that the tools they thought were designed to enable them were actually designed to surveil and extract their intellectual property without attribution? That trust must be mended, but the larger system moves in the indicated direction. Maybe that's enough for survival of the species. Maybe a startup now is a seeking for an object of knowledge or stewardship of a new form of flourishing. Everyone contributes their part, and should get credit for their contribution. Extraction makes you parasitic. We must all become generative.

Dawg, what is that math at 18:54 
1% improvement compounded daily for 1 year is (1+0.01/365)^365 ~ 1.01x
10% improvement compounded monthly each year is 
(1+0.1/12)^12 ~ 1.105x
I think vro got 1% compounded daily confused with 1% growth applied daily.
Obviously 1.01 * 365 > 1.1 * 12
